column3: but found nothing.\nJust broken glass and\nash.{end_wait}
Hey...{pause_20_skippable} Boy...\nCome closer.{end_wait}
You have business with\nme, or are you lost?{end_now}
Vale feels quieter\nwithout you here.{end_wait}
I'm not crying.\nJust go before I do.{end_wait}
Take this.\nYou'll need it out there.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} took\nthe Herb.{end_wait}
You must save {actor_name:6}!{pause_20_skippable}\nBring her home, {actor_name:1}!{end_wait}
Come back alive,\n{actor_name:1}.{page_break}I'll have a proper\nforge waiting.{end_wait}
I thought {actor_name:6}\nmight join our family.{page_break}Now I only hope\nshe's safe.{end_wait}
Those strangers came.\nThe mountain burned.{page_break}And now {actor_name:6}\nis missing.{end_wait}
That masked man...\nHe was {actor_name:5}, right?{end_now}
What if {actor_name:6} knew\nmore than she told us?{end_wait}
What?{pause_20_skippable} But didn't {actor_name:6}\nsee his face?{end_now}
If he's her brother,\nwhat does {actor_name:6} know?{end_wait}
That's not what you\ntold the elders.{end_wait}
We still keep rooms\nready for travelers.{page_break}Even now.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, look after\n{actor_name:2} for me.{page_break}And let him look\nafter you, too.{end_wait}
The Wise One chose you.\nI wish I knew why.{end_wait}
Dora and I will worry\nuntil you're home.{page_break}That's what mothers do.{end_wait}
Please bring back my\ngranddaughter, {actor_name:6}.\n{pause_20_skippable}I'll be waiting.{end_wait}
Since {actor_name:6} was taken,\nGrandmother barely eats.{end_wait}
Kraden studied Alchemy.\nThen the mountain burned.{page_break}People will blame him.{end_wait}
They say whoever caused\nthis had strange powers.{page_break}...{pause_20_skippable}Is that true?{end_now}
Then others can use\nPsynergy, too.{page_break}I don't know what\nthat means for us.{end_wait}
Then perhaps it's\nonly a rumor.{page_break}I'd like to believe it.{end_wait}
Part of me envies you.\nI know I shouldn't.{end_wait}
Don't show your Psynergy\nto strangers.{page_break}Fear makes people cruel.{end_wait}
We guarded the Sanctum\nwithout knowing why.{page_break}Now it's too late\nto ask the elders.{end_wait}
{protagonist_name}, the road\nwill test you.{page_break}Don't let it change\nwho you are.{end_wait}
If you need to\ncome home, come home.{page_break}No one here will\nthink less of you.{end_wait}
If {actor_name:5} took\n{actor_name:6} away...{page_break}why are you the one\nwho must follow?{end_wait}
I'll keep {actor_name:6}\nin my thoughts.{page_break}Please come back,\n{protagonist_name}.{end_wait}
Since {actor_name:6} left,\nthe house feels empty.{page_break}No one can take\nher place.{end_wait}
The masked man was\n{actor_name:5}.{page_break}I still can't\nunderstand it.{end_wait}
I remember {actor_name:5}\nas a gentle boy.{page_break}Could {actor_name:6}\nchange that much too?{end_wait}
{actor_name:5} left in haste.{page_break}Someone found a purse\nnear the road.{end_wait}
I don't want\n{actor_name:2} to go.{page_break}But he has made\nup his mind.{end_wait}
The Wise One chose\n{actor_name:2}.{page_break}That doesn't make\nme less afraid.{end_wait}
When {actor_name:2} leaves,\nI'll wait for news.{page_break}Every day until\nhe comes home.{end_wait}
I worry about\n{actor_name:2}.{page_break}I'll try to trust\nhis judgment.{end_wait}
{actor_name:5} was gifted\nwith Psynergy.{page_break}I hope {actor_name:5}\nuses it to protect.{end_wait}
{actor_name:6}, stay strong.{page_break}Your mother's fire\nis still with you.{end_wait}
Why would {actor_name:5}\ntake {actor_name:6} away?{end_wait}
We nearly lost Vale\nbecause we kept secrets.{end_wait}
I once believed Psynergy\nbelonged only to Vale.{page_break}I was wrong.{end_wait}
If I'd gone with\n{protagonist_name}...{page_break}Maybe I could\nhave helped.{end_wait}
Vale forbids using\nPsynergy outside.{page_break}Remember that,\n{protagonist_name}.{end_wait}
I wish I'd understood\nthe Sanctum sooner.{end_wait}

There are books entitled
"Journey to the Northern
Continent of Angara"{page_break}and "All About the
Southern Continent of
Gondowan."{page_break}{actor_name:1} learned that Mt.
Aleph sits at Angara's
western edge. It burned.{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"The Laws of Vale," which
describes Vale's customs.{page_break}"Never leave the village
without permission.{page_break}Never show Psynergy to
outsiders. Never speak of
the Sanctum..."{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"The Mighty Power of
Nature."{page_break}"Beyond human reason,
nature shows its power in
eruptions{page_break}and floods. It doesn't
spare the innocent..."{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"The Psynergy Stone."{page_break}"Psynergy is restored by
touching a Psynergy Stone.
Some say it feeds on us."{end_wait}

There's a notebook
belonging to {actor_name:6}'s
aunt...{page_break}Sketches by {actor_name:6}'s
aunt and mother as girls.
Happier days.{end_wait}
There's a book entitled\n\"Making a Great Village.\"{page_break}Its margins are filled\nwith names crossed out.{end_wait}

There's a notebook called
"Study of Alchemy."{page_break}"To understand Alchemy,
one must understand the
Elemental Powers..."{page_break}That's where the writing
ends. The rest of the page
is scorched.{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"In Search of the Ancient
Lemurians."{page_break}Someone has underlined:
"They didn't vanish.
They were taken."{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"The Fountain
of Tolbi."{page_break}"The fountain of Tolbi
will test your luck...
Or take it."{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"Encyclopedia of Alchemy"{page_break}"All things are made of
four elements. Even we
return to them..."{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"Legend of Mt. Aleph."{page_break}It says the mountain's
name means the origin of
all things. And its end...{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"Being an Adept."{page_break}"Hone your Psynergy. Do
not use it for evil. It
remembers..."{end_wait}

There's a book entitled
"Etiquette for
Travelers."{page_break}"It's rude not to
introduce yourself to
the town's mayor."{page_break}Beneath it, in pencil:
"Also, check the exits."{end_wait}
